description: This file defines the OrleansException class, a custom exception used within the Orleans runtime for error reporting. It serves as a base class for more specific exceptions and includes constructors for various instantiation scenarios.

classes.name: OrleansException
classes.description: A custom exception class used for reporting errors within the Orleans runtime. It extends the base Exception class and is serializable.

methods.name: OrleansException()
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the OrleansException class with a default message.

methods.name: OrleansException(string message)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance with a specified error message.

methods.name: OrleansException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance with a specified message and inner exception.

methods.name: OrleansException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
